name: Broken Lock
description: The vault's electronic lock is smashed, wires exposed.
inspectText: The lock was forced open with a heavy tool. Sparks from the storm may have shorted it.

name: Muddy Footprint
description: A large, distinct footprint near the vault entrance.
inspectText: The footprint has a unique tread pattern. Size 12, possibly a work boot.

name: Torn Cloth
description: A piece of blue wool fabric caught on the vault door hinge.
inspectText: The cloth is high-quality wool, possibly from a uniform or coat.

name: Empty Jewel Box
description: The velvet-lined box that held the sapphire.
inspectText: The box is empty. There's a thin layer of dust on the bottom, but the center is clean.

name: Spare Keys
description: A set of spare keys to the vault, kept in the curator's desk.
inspectText: All keys are accounted for except one: the master key. A recent copy might exist.

name: Wet Umbrella
description: A wet umbrella in the curator's office.
inspectText: The umbrella is still dripping. But the curator said she didn't go out in the storm.

name: Leather Gloves
description: A pair of leather work gloves, found in the workshop.
inspectText: The gloves have traces of mud and a faint chemical smell.

name: Toolbox
description: A metal toolbox with various tools.
inspectText: A heavy pry bar is missing from the set. The slot is empty.

name: Stolen Sapphire
description: The missing sapphire, hidden in a telescope mount.
inspectText: The sapphire is flawless. It matches the description perfectly.

name: Climbing Rope
description: A long rope tied to the dome's railing.
inspectText: The rope is new and shows signs of recent use. It leads down to the ground.
